title: Simulation with intermediate configurations
statement: Let $P$ be a program with $m$ work tapes and control states of the form $(\lambda,\phi)$, let an oracle assign Boolean answers to deciders on bit strings, let $W$ be an integer, and let $c,c'$ be configurations on input $x$. The configuration $c'$ is reached from $c$ after some finite number $T$ of steps of the run of $P$ with that oracle, and every configuration at a time $t<T$ is intermediate: no represented state is a call state, and all work-tape head positions lie between $-1$ and $W$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: oracle on deciders and bit strings
